# Dataset upload

## Components

### Upload modal

This is the upload screen, which uses a modal to prevent the user from
interacting with other parts of the site until the dataset is either fully
imported (and configured), or discarded. It has a file dialog to upload files
and ok & cancel buttons to proceed or discard.

- file dialog:
    - select dataset file from local machine
- ok button:
    - import dataset
    - hide upload modal
    - show [conf modal](dataset-conf.md#config-modal), which in turn will
      change location to /datasets
- cancel button:
    - discard the uploaded file (if any)
    - close the modal

## Implementation

### Types

```python
FileData = byte array
TableMap = Dict[TableName, OdmTableName]

class DataFile:
    name: str
    content_type: str
    data: FileData

class Dataset:
    name: str
    odm_version: str
    tables: TableMap
    data: FileData
```

### Stores

global:
- `dataset: Dataset`:
    - current/last dataset
    - needed for transition to [dataset conf](dataset-conf.md)
- `datasets: List[Dataset]`:
    - all datasets
- `upload-modal-flag: bool`:
    - signal to show/hide modal
    - callback: set upload-modal.is_open

local:
- `datafile: DataFile`:
    - current uploaded file

### Callbacks

main-menu:
- button 'upload':
    - callback: set upload-modal-flag

upload-modal:
- file-dialog, allowed={'csv', 'xlsx'}, single-file:
    - on_upload(filename, contentType, data):
        - set datafile to DataFile(...)
        - set modal status text to 'upload of x completed'
        - enable ok button
- button, 'ok', disabled:
    - on_click(datafile, datasets):
        - set dataset to [import_dataset](#import_dataset)(datafile)
        - append dataset to datasets
        - reset upload-modal-flag
        - set conf-modal-flag
- button, 'cancel':
    - on_click(datafile):
        - reset datafile
        - reset upload-modal-flag

### Functions

#### import_dataset

`def import_dataset(file: DataFile) -> Dataset`

Returns a dataset object from `file`, with auto-detected values for ODM version
and table mapping.

auto-detects:
- file type from:
    - content type
    - filename extension
- ODM version and table mapping from:
    - table names
    - column names
